name: Mamadou Kiari Liman-Tinguiri
role: Economiste du développement, Président de WASDI, ancien Ambassadeur du Niger aux Etats-Unis
notes: Prominent Nigerien development economist, former senior UN official (UNDP, UNICEF), former Niger Ambassador to the United States (2021-2023), academic (UNC Chapel Hill), and founder of WASDI. Explicitly proposed a progressive net wealth tax on family patrimony in 2017.
